description: builds a count pivot from row and column category fields using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded csv pivot count result before an agent hands structured data or a batch plan to a downstream tool with a stricter contract. Returns the bounded transformation or validation finding with counts, normalized values, and a versioned result contract for CSV Pivot Count as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Processes bounded caller-supplied data in memory only; it performs no file fetch, database write, code execution, or retention.

column_field.description: Column Field supplied to CSV Pivot Count; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

row_field.description: Row Field supplied to CSV Pivot Count; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

text.description: Text supplied to CSV Pivot Count; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

name: util_csv_pivot_count
